status: Approximate manually read image landmarks guide the visible shape; this concept image is not a dimensional mechanical drawing.
interpretation: Positive sagittal x sweep; broad curved root, narrower waist, restrained flare just above the boot. The prior CAD had negative x offsets and therefore bowed in the opposite direction.
fixed_interfaces: Knee bearings, knee axis, pushrod and crank centers, foot center and spherical contact radius remain fixed. Only the structural shin halves and their internal cavity, bosses and channel are revised.
clearance_refinement: The lower centerline returns sooner to preserve the folded pose. Upper transverse depth is locally reduced by 2 mm to clear the thigh during crouch and fold; this does not alter the sagittal silhouette.
historical_revision: Revision 07; superseded by the whole-limb shallow sweep in revision 08. These stations are retained as a record of the earlier design.
